'''2006 World Championship Day 2/3 Bobby Hilburn LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bobby Hilburn]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (Day 2/3); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by John "Asphalizo" Millet (2006-10-24).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35754 Team Stephenville's Worlds 06' QMC (Ellors)]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071209040307/http://decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35754 Internet Archive]</ref>
